User Story/Use Case: Users (students, faculty, and administrators) can register and log in.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): User can enter credentials to gain access to the system.

User Story/Use Case: Admins can create, edit, or delete user accounts.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): User with admin role has the ability to create, edit, and delete user accounts in the system.

User Story/Use Case: Role-based access: admin, event organizer, participant.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): Users will have access and be able to view different parts of the system based on the user's role.

User Story/Use Case: Organizers can create new events with details such as title, date, time, location, and description.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): Event organizer can create an event in the system using specific parameters.

User Story/Use Case: System displays available rooms and venues based on date/time.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): While searching for available rooms in the system, the rooms will be displayed by date/time across the graphical interface.

User Story/Use Case: Users can reserve rooms for approved events.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): While a user has an approved event in the system they can then reserve a room.
When a participant can find an event and click it so they can register for the event.
The system checks the the current list of people registered for an event to ensure theres no duplicate registration.

User Story/Use Case: Attendance tracking and participation records are stored.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): When the system tracks and stores all data related to attendance and participationin XML format.

User Story/Use Case: Email or SMS alerts for upcoming events, cancellations, or schedule changes.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): When an email or sms messege/alert is sent to all users registered for an event.
When a messege is sent to all users registered for an event when the event is beginning soon.

User Story/Use Case: Users can search events by date, organizer, or category.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): When a user is searching for all available events they can filter results shown by date, category.

User Story/Use Case: Filters for ongoing, upcoming, and past events.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): When a user is searching for all available events they can filter results shown by onging, upcoming, and past events.

User Story/Use Case: Participants can leave feedback after attending an event.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): When a participant can provide feedback about an event and submit it to be seen.

User Story/Use Case: Organizers can review and analyze feedback for improvement.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): When an event organizer can view/review submitted feedback from an event they organized.

User Story/Use Case: All data (events, users, bookings) stored in XML format.
Acceptance Criteria (When is it done?): When data about events, users, and bookings is stored everytime its changed in XML format.
